theater: 屏東枋寮石門與恆春半島

battle.name: 石門戰爭
battle.theater: 屏東枋寮石門與恆春半島
battle.brief: 一八七四年五月，日本以懲罰排灣族、保護琉球漁民為名，遣征番使西鄉從道率兵三千六百餘人渡海攻臺灣南部。艦隊以英國船廠建造的鐵甲艦日向、榛名為主力，掩護大軍自恆春楓港登陸，九月進抵枋寮石門，攻破清軍與番社聯防的陣地，逼近恆春。戰事未決而清廷議和，日軍十月撤出臺灣。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的一方是大清帝國的臺灣防線。兵備道劉銘傳於一八七四年五月到任，臺灣鎮總兵唐定奎掌綠營與鎮協，兩人以下設淡水、彰化、噶瑪蘭諸廳，恆春與枋寮一線由營汛與鄉勇分守；上面還有福建巡撫兼總理臺灣海防的沈葆楨在淡水坐鎮，籌措洋槍、火砲與輪船，指揮體系自藩庫、廈門海關與淡水海關一路下達到島上的營哨。另一方是日本明治政府組成的征番軍：陸軍以薩摩、熊本兩藩的舊藩兵為骨幹，由征番使西鄉從道總攬，艦隊由新造海軍的日向、榛名等艦護衛，另有徵用與購置的輸送船隨隊而行。站在清方這一邊的，還有與番社爭地的漢人墾戶與把守各關隘的鄉勇；站在日方這一邊的，是被打上番人標籤、卻各有山寨的排灣族各社。琉球王國在名義上受清廷保護、在實務上受薩摩方面支配，遇害漁民的案子正是三方糾纏的起點。英國商人與外交官在淡水、福州之間居間斡旋，成為談判的第三方。
countriesEn: One side was the Taiwan defence establishment of the Great Qing. Liu Mingchuan took up the post of Taiwan Circuit Vice-Commander in the fifth month of 1874, while the brigadier-general of Taiwan, Tang Dingkui, held the Green Standard and the provincial battalions; below them stood the subprefectures of Danshui, Zhanghua and Kavalan, and the line at Hengchun and Fangliao was kept by garrison companies and locally raised braves. Above them sat Shen Baozhen, the Fujian governor and imperial commissioner for the overall defence of Taiwan's coasts, who stayed at Danshui arranging imported rifles, guns and steamers, so that the chain of command ran from the provincial treasury, the Amoy customs and the Tamsui customs all the way down to the outposts on the island. The other side was the punitive expedition assembled by the Meiji government of Japan: the land force had the old domain levies of Satsuma and Kumamoto at its core, with the expedition commissioner Saigo Tsugumichi in overall command, the squadron was escorted by the new navy through the Hyuga and the Haruna, and hired and purchased transports travelled in company. Standing on the Qing side as well were the Han settlers who contested the tribal lands and the braves who manned the passes; on the Japanese side stood the Paiwan villages, labelled as barbarians but each with its own stockade. The Ryukyu kingdom was nominally under Qing protection and in practice under Satsuma direction, and the case of the murdered fishermen was the point at which all three strands came together. British merchants and consular officials acted as intermediaries between Tamsui and Fuzhou and became a third party in the negotiations.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊。日本一方是薩摩西鄉氏出身的西鄉從道（1823至1877），早年遊學京都，歸國後主薩摩藩的洋務與軍政，一八七一年琉球漁民遇害事件發生時，他以薩摩方面代表的身分參與向清廷交涉的準備，一八七四年受任征番使，率三千六百餘人渡海，把這場遠征做成一次大規模的實兵演練；一八七二年先遣赴臺收購遇害者遺骸的隊伍，則由佐賀藩出身的有馬四郎助率領，兩次行動都因清方與番社的推拒而未能善了。艦隊由熟悉南洋航路的人員指揮，日向、榛名兩艘英國船廠建造的鐵甲艦擔任掩護與輸送的骨幹。清方主持者是劉銘傳（1836至1896），淮軍出身，他到任後立即在枋寮石門一線加固砲台、募勇、編查戶口，並首倡以招撫代替剿殺，是日後開山撫番的制度起點；臺灣鎮總兵唐定奎（1810至1877）主持恆春、枋寮的實際防務。更高層的有沈葆楨（1820至1879），他以欽差大臣兼總理臺灣海防的身分籌備島防，最後由沈有容（1824至1879）赴福州、淡水對日議和。番社方面，清方檔案多只記番目，少有可對號的個人姓名，各社頭目在日軍以現銀收買之下態度各異。
peopleEn: The key figures belong to the two sides. On the Japanese side there was Saigo Tsugumichi (1823-1877), born of the Satsuma Saigo clan, who had studied in Kyoto in his youth and afterwards took charge of the Satsuma domain's Western learning and military administration; when the Ryukyuan fishermen were killed in 1871 he took part in preparing the representations to the Qing court, and in 1874 he was appointed expedition commissioner and took more than thirty-six hundred men across the sea, turning the expedition into a full-scale field trial of the new army. The advance party that went to Taiwan in 1872 to buy back the remains of the victims was led by Arima Shirosuke, a samurai of the Saga domain, and neither mission could be settled because the Qing side and the villages refused them. The squadron was directed by officers who knew the southern sea lanes, and the two ironclads built in British yards, the Hyuga and the Haruna, formed its covering force and its spine for transport. On the Qing side the man in charge was Liu Mingchuan (1836-1896), a leader of the Huai Army, who on taking office at once reinforced the batteries on the Shimen line at Fangliao, raised braves and compiled household registers, and was the first to propose pacification by negotiation in place of extermination, which became the institutional starting point of the later policy of opening the mountains and winning over the tribes. The brigadier-general of Taiwan, Tang Dingkui (1810-1877), directed the actual defence of Hengchun and Fangliao. Above them stood Shen Baozhen (1820-1879), who as imperial commissioner for the defence of Taiwan's coasts prepared the island's defences, and it was Shen Yourong (1824-1879) who went to Fuzhou and Tamsui to negotiate the settlement with Japan. On the tribal side the Qing files mostly record only headmen by title and few personal names can be matched to individuals, and the attitude of the various village headmen varied once the Japanese began buying them off with cash.
kits: 卡面上的鐵甲艦是一八六二年下水英國主力艦的類型，中央炮廓式、外覆鐵甲、木殼包鐵，是砲塔設計從此繞著裝甲轉的起點。日本在一八七四年用上的日向與榛名，正是照英國同型船建造的兩艘早期鐵甲艦，排水量在千六百噸上下，舷側列佈速射砲，中央或兩端設主砲，以蒸汽機帶動螺旋槳。在石門之役裡，鐵甲艦並不負責攻寨：艦隊停泊恆春外海，負責的是封鎖南部海岸、掩護登陸、偵察灘頭、輸送糧彈與人員，只有在掩護登陸與支援岸上射擊時才用上主砲；真正攻破木石寨牆的是野砲曲射與步槍近射，遠洋重砲對山寨確實無能為力。步兵方面，日軍以舊式前裝洋槍配刺刀為主，攜帶輕型山砲，工兵帶壕溝器材與爆破藥包，後勤靠隨軍輸送船與徵用漁船自琉球那霸接運，軍馬用於拖曳砲車與糧車。清軍以綠營的冷槍、抬槍為骨幹，洋槍數量有限，火砲仍是仿製的舊式抬砲與劈山砲，寨牆用磚石木柵，糧秣靠廈門、福州海運再以牛車挑夫接續，番社既無馬匹亦無重砲，只有獵前裝火槍、弓矢與長刀，並以獨木舟沿溪流搬運。
kitsEn: The ironclad on the card is the type of the British capital ship launched in 1862, the central-battery ironclad with a wooden hull sheathed in iron armour, and it is the point at which turret design began to work around the armour. The Hyuga and the Haruna used by Japan in 1874 were the two early ironclads built to the same British pattern, of roughly sixteen hundred tons, with quick-firing guns ranged along the broadside, a main armament in the central or end battery, and screws driven by steam engines. In the fighting at Shimen the ironclads had no part in the assault on the stockades. The squadron lay off Hengchun, and its work was to blockade the southern coast, cover the landings, reconnoitre the beaches and carry stores and men; the main guns were used only to cover the landing and to support the troops ashore, and the breaching of the timber and stone walls was really the work of howitzers firing at a curve and of rifle fire at close range, for heavy guns afloat were plainly helpless against a mountain stockade. On the infantry side the Japanese marched with old muzzle-loading rifles and bayonets and carried light field guns, while their sappers brought entrenching tools and blasting charges; supplies came by army transports and by hired fishing boats from the Ryukyuan base at Naha, and horses were used to drag guns and baggage. The Qing relied on the cold rifles and sedan guns of the Green Standard, had only a limited number of imported rifles, and their artillery was still imitated old muzzle-loaders and mountain pieces; the stockade walls were built of brick, stone and timber, and grain came by sea from Amoy and Fuzhou and then by cart and on porters' backs. The villages had neither horses nor heavy guns, only hunting muzzleloaders, bows and long knives, and they moved stores on dugout canoes down the creeks.
tactics: 日軍的戰法是近代化的正面攻略加金錢收買。艦隊先行在恆春與楓港外海巡弋，探清水深與灘位，再以海軍火砲壓制岸上守軍，部隊搭乘小艇與徵用漁船分批登陸，集中兵力逐社攻取，不作長距離追擊：對願降的頭目以現銀交換引路與停戰，對不降的社寨則以步砲曲射先壓住寨門射孔，再由突擊隊與工兵攻破寨牆，奪下之後立刻修築道路、設立屯糧點，枋寮與恆春成為兩端補給基地，前進軸線沿海岸與溪谷展開，避開崎嶇的內陸山道。掩護上以連續射擊配合刺刀近戰，野砲射程雖及不上寨牆，卻能封住村內道路，日軍多以土壘與木柵築射擊陣，缺工程能力之處便用現金代替攻擊。清軍與番社則採據點式防禦：石門、枋寮一線設砲台、壕溝與哨所，番社以木石寨居高臨下用獵槍與弓矢射擊，清軍屢次出城反擊，卻因全臺分散駐防、糧秣靠海運再抬運，溪水一漲即斷，難以持久。石門失守後日軍並未深入追擊，而是就地設界線，等待談判的結果。
tacticsEn: The Japanese method was modern frontal assault mixed with payment. The squadron first cruised off Hengchun and Fenggang to sound the depths and the beaches, the shore was then beaten down by naval gunfire, and troops landed in small boats and hired fishing craft brought ashore in batches. Strength was concentrated on one village at a time, with no long pursuit. Headmen who were willing to submit were bought off with cash in return for guiding and a truce; villages that would not yield were first suppressed by the curved fire of the field guns on the loopholes of the gates, and then a storming party with the sappers broke the wall. The road was immediately repaired and a grain depot set up, so that Fangliao and Hengchun became the two ends of the supply line, and the axis of advance followed the coast and the creek valleys rather than the rough tracks of the interior. Cover came from continuous fire and bayonet work; although the field guns could not reach the walls they sealed the paths inside the village, and the Japanese built firing positions of earth banks and timber fences, substituting cash for assault wherever they lacked engineering capacity. The Qing and the villages defended by strongpoint, with batteries, ditches and posts along the Shimen and Fangliao line, the villages holding timber and stone stockades on high ground and shooting down with hunting guns and bows. The Qing sorted out of the city more than once, only to find that with the garrison scattered across the whole island and grain coming by sea and then on men's backs, a rise in the creeks cut the line at once and the defence could not be sustained. After Shimen fell the Japanese did not pursue inland; they held a line on the spot and waited for the outcome of the negotiations.
data: 可核的數字大致如下。一八七四年五月日本出兵臺灣，陸上兵員三千六百五十八人、軍艦乘員七百三十四人；日軍戰死十二人、病死五百六十一人，遠多於陣亡，反映五月至九月間熱帶傳染病的威脅。番社方面參戰人數約六百人，戰死至少二十餘人，負傷五十餘人。議和結果為五十萬兩銀，拆作撫恤十萬兩與購買道路房屋四十萬兩。一八七四年十月，李鴻章奏准淮軍十三營六千五百人分批赴臺，兵尚未渡海而和約已定，於是全數留駐原地。時間線是：五月出兵、六月抵琉球那霸設基地、九月自恆春楓港登陸並在枋寮石門交戰、十月撤出臺灣，全役前後約五個月；航程由鹿兒島經那霸到恆春，總計逾一千公里。地理上，石門位於今屏東縣枋寮鄉，距恆春城約二十餘公里；楓港即今車城，距恆春亦約二十公里。事件本身另計：一八七一年十二月八瑤灣事件共死六十九人，其中琉球人五十四、華人十二、日本人三人。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. When Japan sent troops to Taiwan in the fifth month of 1874, the number ashore was three thousand six hundred and fifty-eight men and the ship's companies numbered seven hundred and thirty-four. The Japanese lost twelve killed and five hundred and sixty-one dead of disease, far more than in the fighting, which shows the weight of tropical disease between May and September. On the tribal side the participating villages numbered about six hundred men, with at least twenty-odd killed and more than fifty wounded. The settlement came to five hundred thousand taels of silver, split into one hundred thousand in compensation and four hundred thousand for the purchase of roads and buildings. In the tenth month of 1874 Li Hongzhang obtained approval for thirteen Huai Army battalions, six thousand five hundred strong, to sail to Taiwan in batches; before the troops had crossed the water the agreement was already fixed, so all of them stayed where they were. The timetable was: departure in May, arrival at Naha in the Ryukyus in June to serve as a base, landing at Fenggang on Hengchun and the clash at Shimen near Fangliao in September, and withdrawal from Taiwan in October, the whole operation lasting about five months. The route ran from Kagoshima through Naha to Hengchun, a total of more than a thousand kilometres. Geographically, Shimen lies in today's Fangliao township in Pingtung county, about twenty-odd kilometres from the walls of Hengchun; Fenggang is today's Checheng, also about twenty kilometres from Hengchun. The incident itself is counted separately: the Bayaowan incident of December 1871 killed sixty-nine people in all, of whom fifty-four were Ryukyuans, twelve were Chinese and three were Japanese.
cause: 遠因是琉球王國的處置。琉球向來是清朝的藩屬，同時又在薩摩藩的航運與貿易圈之內，一八七一年《尖閣諸島議定書》雖以一款確認琉球屬於中國，卻沒有解決漁業糾紛與海難善後。一八七一年十二月，琉球漁船遇風漂流至臺灣南部八瑤灣，被牡丹社居民殺害，六十九人罹難，琉球藩向清廷交涉三年不得結果。日本明治政府成立後想解決琉球的宗主歸屬，卻不想以割讓領土換取清朝讓步，遂以護漁懲兇為名走向出兵：一八七二年先遣有馬四郎助赴臺收購遺骸遭拒，一八七四年再由征番使西鄉從道領兵。同時關內有以制裁番人取代清廷招撫的輿論，薩摩舊藩的武士主張以武力打通臺灣、斷絕清廷招撫的財源，明治政府則借出兵既解決琉球案件、又試驗新軍與新造海軍的實戰能力，這是兵制改革以來第一次海外用兵。清方自身的困弱也是原因之一：全臺兵力分散、綠營久疏戰陣、火砲與輪船不足，番社與漢人墾戶在恆春、枋寮一帶爭地已久，日軍一到便立刻填上了這個空隙。
causeEn: The deep cause lay in the disposition of the Ryukyu kingdom. Ryukyu had always been a vassal of the Qing while also sitting inside the trading and shipping orbit of the Satsuma domain, and the convention of 1871 on the Diaoyu and Senkaku groups did settle that Ryukyu was China's, but settled nothing about fishing disputes or the care of shipwrecked men. In December 1871 a Ryukyuan fishing boat was blown off course to Bayaowan in southern Taiwan and its crew was killed by the people of the Mudan village, sixty-nine dead in all, and the Ryukyu government petitioned the Qing court for three years without result. The newly established Meiji government wanted to settle the question of Ryukyu's allegiance, but did not want to pay for it by ceding territory, and so moved towards sending troops under the banner of protecting the fishermen and punishing the murderers: in 1872 Arima Shirosuke was sent to Taiwan to buy back the remains and was refused, and in 1874 Saigo Tsugumichi was appointed expedition commissioner and led the force in person. At the same time opinion inside Japan held that punishing the tribes should take the place of Qing pacification, the old Satsuma samurai argued that the way to open Taiwan and cut off the Qing government's source of recruits was by force, and the Meiji government used the expedition both to settle the Ryukyu case and to test the new army and the newly built navy in action, which was the first overseas use of force since the army reforms. The Qing side had its own weakness as a cause: the island's garrison was scattered, the Green Standard had long lost its fighting edge, and there were not enough guns or steamers, while the friction between the tribes and Han settlers in the Hengchun and Fangliao area had been building for years, and the Japanese filled that gap the moment they arrived.
impact: 這場遠征是日本第一次以國家名義在海外用兵而告成功，第一層後果落在臺灣。清廷在石門失守、耗銀五十萬兩了結之後，才真正意識到島的邊防無力，隨即由沈葆楨推動開山撫番，設恆春廳、旋改恆春縣，把排灣族諸社編入版籍，並且以劉銘傳主持的開山築路為長期政策，之後的電報、基隆煤礦與新竹至基隆的鐵路都由此而來；對番社而言，社域不再受朝廷庇護而改由官署直接治理，漢人墾殖與番社的摩擦從此長期化，到一九三〇年代仍有霧台等地的衝突。第二層後果落在日本。西鄉從道因這次遠征的政績回到中央，兩年後成為西南戰爭西南軍的總帥，日軍則證明遠征與後方補給可以配合；但石門之役也暴露鐵甲艦對內陸山寨攻擊幾乎無用，遠洋重砲追不上山、進不了寨，於是日本海軍內部開始反省巨砲主義，走向速射砲與快速巡洋艦的方向，這條路最後通向一八九四年甲午海戰的艦隊。第三層後果落在中日關係：條約以琉球歸清廷處置換取日本撤兵，日本承認清廷對臺灣的主張，卻在國內留下更強的輿論，二十一年後的馬關條約割讓臺灣由此發端。
impactEn: This expedition was the first time Japan fought overseas in the name of the state, and it succeeded, and the first layer of consequences fell on Taiwan. After Shimen fell and the court had paid five hundred thousand taels to close the case, the Qing finally understood that the island's frontier defence was hollow, and Shen Baozhen at once pushed the policy of opening the mountains and winning over the tribes, setting up the Hengchun subprefecture, later made into a county, bringing the Paiwan villages into the register, and making the road-building of Liu Mingchuan a long-term policy, from which the telegraph, the Keelung coal mines and the railway from Hsinchu to Keelung all grew. For the villages this meant that their territory was no longer shielded by the court but governed directly by officialdom, and that friction between Han settlement and tribal land became a long-running condition which still produced clashes such as the Wutai disturbances of the 1930s. The second layer of consequences fell on Japan. Saigo Tsugumichi returned to the centre on the strength of his success in the expedition and two years later became commander-in-chief of the southwestern army in the Satsuma Rebellion, while the Japanese army had proved that expedition and lines of communication could be combined. But Shimen also showed that ironclads were almost useless against a mountain stockade, for heavy guns afloat could not climb the hills or breach the walls, and the navy in Japan began to rethink the gospel of big guns and to move towards quick-firing guns and fast cruisers, the road that ended in the fleet of 1894. The third layer fell on Sino-Japanese relations: the treaty exchanged the handling of Ryukyu for the Japanese withdrawal, so Japan recognised the Qing claim to Taiwan while the stronger opinion it left behind at home hardened, and the cession of Taiwan by the Treaty of Shimonoseki twenty-one years later grew out of it.
result: 石門之戰的結局是日軍攻下枋寮、逼近恆春，番社與清軍的聯防崩潰，參戰各社死傷二十餘人，被俘者由征番使送回社內，日軍因已見清廷使節在途、談判可期，遂止兵於枋寮與恆春一線，不再深入。九月十日，中日訂立北京專約：日本撤回臺灣，清朝以五十萬兩銀支付撫恤與收買道路房屋的費用，並承諾懲處番社、禁止漢人越界滋事，琉球的處置則歸清廷；十月，日軍自恆春撤出臺灣。這一場以武力換取承認的結果，雙方都不算全勝：日本用五百餘人的病亡與遠征費用換得的是清朝對琉球的讓步，卻沒有換到島上任何據點，日後仍須以更強的軍力再來；清朝以白銀換回國土，卻把臺灣邊防的破口完全暴露在東亞強權面前，於是開山撫番與海防重建成為接下來二十年的國策，番社則夾在兩個國家之間，既要應付新的官署，又失去了舊日的緩衝。
resultEn: The outcome at Shimen was that the Japanese took Fangliao and came close to Hengchun, the joint defence of the villages and the Qing troops collapsed, the participating villages lost more than twenty dead, and the prisoners were sent back to the villages by the expedition commissioner. Since envoys from the Qing were already on the water and negotiation could be expected, the Japanese stopped at the line of Fangliao and Hengchun and did not strike deeper. On the tenth of September the two states concluded the Convention of Peking: Japan withdrew its troops from Taiwan, the Qing paid five hundred thousand taels in compensation and for the purchase of roads and buildings and promised to punish the villages and to stop Han people crossing the line, while the handling of Ryukyu passed to the Qing; in October the Japanese withdrew from Hengchun and left Taiwan. The result was an exchange of force for recognition that left neither side content. Japan had paid five hundred-odd men dead of disease and the cost of the expedition to obtain a Qing concession over Ryukyu, but had won no foothold on the island and would have to come back with a stronger fleet. The Qing had bought back its own territory with silver, and at the same time laid the island's exposed frontier bare before the powers of East Asia, so that opening the mountains and rebuilding the defences became the state's policy for the following twenty years, while the tribes were caught between two states, having to serve a new officialdom and having lost the buffer they had relied on.
